snippet.title: Bottom of the 9th (1996) PS1 - Gameplay HD
snippet.description:
Bottom of the 9th is a baseball game by Konami for the PlayStation, which was later ported to the Sega Saturn and the Nintendo 64. It is a heavily updated version of Konami's 1989 arcade game Bottom of the Ninth.

Initial release date: April 4, 1996
Mode: Multiplayer video game
Original author: Konami
Designer: Greg Orduyan
Platforms: Android, Nintendo 64, Microsoft Windows, Linux, Playstation, macOS, Sega Saturn
Developers: Handelabra Games, Konami
Genres: Sports Video Game, Indie game, Simulation Game, Strategy, Sports
